CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFLDAP

In ColdFusion 4.5, CFLDAP searches an LDAP directory, such as a company phone book, and returns the entries as a query; it can also add, modify and delete entries. KoldFusion recognizes the tag, but the Netscape Directory SDK it needs is not part of this server, so every call throws an Application exception.

Category

Internet protocols

Syntax

<CFLDAP SERVER="server_name"
    PORT="port_number"
    USERNAME="name"
    PASSWORD="password"
    ACTION="action"
    NAME="name"
    TIMEOUT="seconds"
    MAXROWS="number"
    START="distinguished_name"
    SCOPE="scope"
    ATTRIBUTES="attribute, attribute"
    FILTER="filter"
    SORT="attribute[, attribute]..."
    DN="distinguished_name"
    STARTROW="row_number"
    MODIFYTYPE="replace">

Attributes

SERVER
Required. Host name or address of the LDAP server. It appears in the error message.
PORT
Optional, default "389". Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
USERNAME
Optional. User for an authenticated bind. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
PASSWORD
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
ACTION
Optional, default "Query". Query, Add, Modify, ModifyDN or Delete. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
NAME
Required for Query. Name of the result query. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
TIMEOUT
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
MAXROWS
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
START
Required for Query. Distinguished name where the search starts. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
SCOPE
Optional, default "OneLevel". OneLevel, Base or Subtree. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
ATTRIBUTES
Required for Query, Add, Modify. Attributes to return or set. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
FILTER
Optional, default "objectclass=*". Search filter. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
SORT
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
DN
Required for Add, Modify, ModifyDN, Delete. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
STARTROW
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
MODIFYTYPE
Optional. Add, Delete or Replace. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.

Usage

The exception has TYPE="Application", the message "Error processing CFLDAP" and a detail that names the server. Pages that may also run on a Windows NT ColdFusion server can catch it and fall back on a database lookup, as the example does with the Employees table.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFTRY>
  <CFLDAP ACTION="Query" SERVER="ldap.allair.example" NAME="People"
          START="o=Allair, c=US" SCOPE="Subtree"
          FILTER="(ou=Engineering)" ATTRIBUTES="cn,mail,telephoneNumber">
  <CFCATCH TYPE="Application">
    <CFOUTPUT><P><B>#CFCATCH.Message#:</B> #CFCATCH.Detail#</P></CFOUTPUT>
    <!--- Use the company database as the phone book instead --->
    <CFQUERY NAME="People" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets" MAXROWS="5">
    SELECT LastName AS cn, Email AS mail, Phone AS telephoneNumber
    FROM Employees WHERE Department = 'Engineering' ORDER BY LastName
    </CFQUERY>
  </CFCATCH>
</CFTRY>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>cn</TH><TH>mail</TH><TH>telephoneNumber</TH></TR>
<CFOUTPUT QUERY="People">
<TR><TD>#cn#</TD><TD>#mail#</TD><TD>#telephoneNumber#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</TABLE>
